title: Onboard compact asymmetric encoder; publish stability matrix and pin mapping
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Onboard a new compact asymmetric vector encoder (asymm-enc-v2) that produces 192-d embeddings from legacy 256-d pipelines via a learned projection. Deliverables: artifact registration, deterministic version pin mapping for Dedicated/Private customers, automated perf/stability matrix and a published profile bundle for the catalog. This ticket focuses on integration tests, deterministic pin rules, fallback mapping for incompatible consumers (reranker variants), and publishing the stability matrix and profile bundle to the model catalog.
acceptance_criteria: asymm-enc-v2 artifacts uploaded to artifact-store with canonical manifest and checksums
performance profile (latency/cost/embedding-drift) generated for host GPUs and reported in the catalog
pin mapping created and validated for runtime-1.22; canary rollout succeeds in staging for both hosted and Dedicated modes
fallback policy defined for rerankers expecting 256-d vectors: deterministic up-sample vs runtime re-encoder path tested
security review completed and KMS-wrapped keys confirmed for private deployment packages
steps: Receive model artifacts from research (checkpoint, tokenizer, projection matrix) and confirm licenses
Write manifest with canonical metadata: version, architecture tags, quantization profile, embedding-dim, stable-hash
Run standardized perf harness across target GPUs at typical shard sizes (seq=128, batch mixing) to collect latency and tail metrics
Evaluate embedding drift vs baseline (256-d reference) using 10k representative prompts and report semantic-sim and MRR changes
Generate stability matrix CSV (model x hardware x quantization x seq_len) and attach to profile bundle
Create deterministic pin mapping file for runtime: maps model+variant -> pinned artifact hash and compatible reranker variants
Implement a small shim in catalog adapter that advertises 192-d shape and includes an auto-upscale path for rerankers; add compatibility tests
Publish profile bundle to catalog and schedule staged rollout (canary 5% traffic -> 25% -> 100%) with automated regression checks
comments: 2025-02-25 - Aisha Patel: Created ticket after sync with Research (Sofia) and Product (Liam). Research provided quantized checkpoint and lightweight projection; flagged KMS requirement for Private bundles.

2025-02-28 - Marco Nguyen: Started artifact ingestion. Found tokenizer mismatch for some vocab tokens (special tokens order). Opened PR to standardize tokenizer metadata. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/models/pull/1423

2025-03-01 - QA: Ran first pass perf harness on A100-80GB and T4; median latency looks good but p95 on T4 exceeded target by 18% for batch sizes > 8. Investigation points to serialization overhead in projection step.

2025-03-02 - Marco Nguyen: Implemented a micro-optim in projection operator (fused GEMM+norm). Rerun shows p95 reduction ~12% on T4; still short of SLO. Added micro-batching config suggestion to profile bundle.

2025-03-03 - Product (Liam Chen): Reviewed stability matrix draft. Requested explicit compatibility guidance for reranker consumers; prefer deterministic up-sample mapping as primary and runtime re-encoder as fallback. Added to acceptance criteria.

2025-03-04 - Security (Nina Rao): Performed initial security checklist. Noted that Private delivery must include signed manifest and KMS key rotation notes. Marked security_review_required = true and requested additional docs.

2025-03-05 - Marco Nguyen: Canary preparation complete in staging: pinned artifact hash 6f2a9b3 uploaded. Canary smoke tests include embedding drift check with threshold 0.015 cosine loss. Preparing rollout playbook and rollback triggers.
